verdict.rationale: The docs define a skill as a plain directory containing a `SKILL.md` file (with `name`/`description` frontmatter) plus optional scripts and references, and say skills build on the open agent skills standard and live in `.agents/skills` folders. A hands-on probe used third-party tooling (`npx skills add`) to install a catalog skill as a plain folder with a valid frontmatter `SKILL.md`, and the docs describe a portable Agent Plugins manifest and a Claude Code migration path. Community comments independently describe skills as free-form Markdown files. missing for 10: no end-to-end demonstration of a Codex skill actually running in a different, non-Codex harness (the probe installed with the `-a codex` target).
